Ran `pytest tests/test_trail_isolation.py` and quoted the 13/13 passing test results in the PR body. Cleaned up `/tmp/mcp2-verify` after verification without touching the shared `.venv`.
5. **Git & PR Update**: Amended commit with `X-Agent: agy/requirements-declaration-sync` trailer, force-pushed to `origin/agy/requirements-declaration-sync`, and updated PR #6410 title and body to state that `mcp` is ported forward to 2.0.
